config.test_aggregation: seed-mean statistic and studentised statistic, seed-median p-value
views: generator-level (exact perm., n = number of generators)
caveats: Wilson 95% CI across universes assumes independent universes; universes share every TEST date and overlap in tickers, so it is descriptive
nominal HAC / wild p-values are oversized in this configuration; part placebo measures the size and gives size-adjusted shares (placebo pooled over universes)
critic inputs are standardised with the pooled training half (generator-dependent scale; no library option for a fixed scale)
the link has 5 generators: pooled and within-universe correlations mostly rank them; the generator-level correlation has n = 5
